premise: Owl and Bear cub are napping and Mushroom feels a sneeze coming — ah… ah… — she holds it and holds it until ACHOO! a puff of glitter, so pretty that the sleepers wake up smiling.
inspiration: The folk "don't wake the baby" tale of a household tiptoeing round a sleeper, turned: the thing everyone dreaded turns out lovely.
lesson: Little accidents can turn into lovely surprises.

en-US.title: Mushroom Holds a Sneeze
en-US.text: [softly] It was nap time in the meadow. {bear:enter} Bear cub came toddling up, {bear:live hold} gave a great big yawn and nodded off. {sfx:snore} Up on a branch, {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Owl, who had been awake all night, blinked a sleepy blink and {owl:live hold} fell asleep too. [whispers] Shhh. Then little {mushroom:enter} Mushroom felt something. {mushroom:face surprised} A tickle. A sneeze was coming! Oh no, not now! {mushroom:live hold} Ah… ah… She held it. And held it. {mushroom:shake 0.4} Her cap trembled. A leaf drifted past. [slowly] Ah… AH… [pause] {mushroom:live resume} {sfx:achoo} ACHOO! A puff of glitter floated up, twinkling. {bear:live resume} Bear cub woke with a start. {owl:live resume} Owl opened one eye, then the other. {mushroom:face sad} [sad] Sorry, whispered Mushroom. But Bear cub {bear:face happy} was smiling. [gasps] Sparkles! {owl:face happy} Hoo, said Owl. The prettiest sneeze I ever saw. {all:face happy} {all:hop} Bless you! said everyone. And ever since, when Mushroom feels a sneeze coming, nobody says shhh. {mushroom:glow} Everybody waits for the sparkles.

es-ES.title: Seta aguanta un estornudo
es-ES.text: [softly] Era la hora de la siesta en el prado. {bear:enter} Osito llegó caminando despacito, {bear:live hold} dio un bostezo enorme y se quedó dormido. {sfx:snore} En una rama, {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Búho, que había pasado la noche despierto, parpadeó con sueño y {owl:live hold} se durmió también. [whispers] Chsss. Entonces la pequeña {mushroom:enter} Seta notó algo. {mushroom:face surprised} Un cosquilleo. ¡Le venía un estornudo! ¡Ay, no, ahora no! {mushroom:live hold} Aaa… aaa… Lo aguantó. Y lo aguantó. {mushroom:shake 0.4} Le temblaba el sombrero. Pasó flotando una hoja. [slowly] Aaa… AAA… [pause] {mushroom:live resume} {sfx:achoo} ¡ACHÍS! Subió un soplo de purpurina, brillando. {bear:live resume} Osito se despertó con un respingo. {owl:live resume} Búho abrió un ojo, y luego el otro. {mushroom:face sad} [sad] Perdón, susurró Seta. Pero Osito {bear:face happy} sonreía. [gasps] ¡Chispitas! {owl:face happy} Uuu, dijo Búho. El estornudo más bonito que he visto nunca. {all:face happy} {all:hop} ¡Salud! dijeron todos. Y desde entonces, cuando a Seta le viene un estornudo, nadie dice chsss. {mushroom:glow} Todos esperan las chispitas.

snore.prompt: a small bear cub snoring softly and slowly, cute and gentle

achoo.prompt: a tiny, cute comic sneeze, achoo, with a soft sparkly twinkle after it, playful
